item.title: ITTS reports first-half growth as ERP and AI projects gain traction
item.summary: Information Technology Total Services (ITTS) said its business recovered in the first half of 2026 as enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation work advanced and data governance and other smart applications began going live at customer sites. The Taiwanese SAP consulting and managed-services provider said enterprise demand for AI is now tied to broader work on data integration, governance, and process redesign rather than single-tool deployments.
